content.short: Avatr tokenizes talent via fractional NFTs representing measured performance to reward creators and NFT holders.
content.description: Avatr is an NFT-based platform that aims to reshape peer-to-peer recruitment by tokenizing talent. Each participant—candidates and employers—creates an Avatr composed of fractionalized NFTs. An Avatr represents a creator’s measured performance in a tokenized form, enabling rewards for both the creator and NFT holders. Avatr NFTs are offered to the community through purchases, referrals, or rewards, turning demonstrated performance into tradable digital assets that align incentives for all stakeholders.
